answer: The island is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the karst. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
